notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API transfer-epoch scenario: two published candidates receive tagged assumption offers after unconditional divestiture; the ownership query verifies the former owner is unowned (§7.1.2). The first candidate acquires the transferred set. The test then drains the other candidate's callbacks and asserts no additional Request Attribute Ownership Assumption after ownership is established, directly covering requirement-candidate-content-clauses-04-federation-management-page-059-l8-1-owned (§4.12). A later explicit divestiture starts a fresh epoch and the other candidate receives a new tagged offer. Other direct mappings: page-148-l61-18/l70-21 -> §7.1, p150-l116-36 -> §7.1.2, and page-154-l162-51 -> §7.2. Adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model and logical-time implementation. This C++ public-API test is not a conformance claim.
